lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered 2D array of high-intensity circular pixel clusters positioned posterior to the pectoral fin; primary cluster group forms a grid spanning the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Sub-vertical bands of high-luminance pixels intersecting the circular clusters, creating high-contrast nodal points at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper and mid-flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition (light to dark) indicating structural ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated within the lower two-thirds of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.
